experience.description: Developing AI-powered home automation system with error detection capabilities using event sourcing and AI.
responsibilities: Collaborating in a team of 4 members under the guidance of a Senior Architect.
Developing a prototype for detecting errors in a home automation system using event sourcing logs and AI.
Collecting large-scale sensor and system event data, including deliberately introduced faults, to train AI models for anomaly detection and corrective action recommendations.
Integrating AI with system code access to enable autonomous optimization, real-time decision-making, and providing suggestions for detected errors.

projects.title: EduMate KCET-Personalized Rank-to-College Advisor
description: A personalized KCET rank-to-college recommendation platform that helps students choose the best college and branch based on their rank.
Provides cutoff trends, peer reviews, and intelligent suggestions to reduce manual research time.
Integrates AI-driven validation and real-time features for a smarter counseling experience.
features: Personalized college and branch recommendations based on KCET rank
Interactive cutoff trend visualization
Peer-to-peer counseling with Jitsi Meet integration
AI-based review validation using TF-IDF and Logistic Regression
OCR-based student ID verification system
Role-based authentication and secure JWT login
Drag-and-drop choice filling with real-time data persistence

projects.title: ML Powered Flood Prediction System
description: An AI-driven flood early warning system that provides real-time risk alerts and 3-day flood forecasts.
Leverages climate and disaster datasets to help authorities and communities take preventive actions.
Combines machine learning models with an interactive dashboard for visualization and decision support.
features: Real-time flood risk prediction and alert system
3-day forecast using hybrid XGBoost and LSTM model
Integration with NASA POWER climate data and EM-DAT disaster records
Interactive dashboard with maps and area heatmaps
Multi-city monitoring and simulation capabilities
SHAP-based explainability for model predictions
Full-stack implementation with FastAPI backend and React frontend

projects.title: Water Monitoring System
description: Developed a Water Monitoring System leveraging IoT technologies to optimize water usage and mitigate wastage, using Raspberry Pi, water flow sensors, and Twilio.
It sends instant alerts via Twilio's communication API to notify users about abnormal water usage or potential issues.
The project integrates Python-based visualization tools and the ThingSpeak platform to provide actionable insights and track water consumption trends.
features: Real-time water flow measurement and monitoring
Automatic alerts for abnormal or excess water usage
Data logging and visualization on ThingSpeak platform
Web interface built with Django for monitoring and reports
Email and SMS notifications using Twilio and Smtplib
